name: Zhui Ye Ren
source:
As time marches forward and the past fades away, do we linger in what was, or step toward what is to come?

When life at the antique shop spiraled into a cycle of trivialities and aimless wandering, Ery never could have imagined what the coming week would hold—all sparked by a strange commission letter dropped into his mailbox.

In the journey ahead—an adventure born of chance—Eli may find that he isn't just helping himself, but also another lonely soul wandering through the dark of night.

[From [url=https://cambrian42.itch.io/thenightchaser]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
时光荏苒，往事渐行渐远，我们是停留在过去，还是迈向未来？

当古董店的生活陷入琐碎和漫无目的地徘徊的循环时，埃里永远无法想象接下来的一周会发生什么——这一切都是由一封落在他邮箱里的奇怪的委托信引发的。

在未来的旅程中——一次偶然的冒险——伊莱可能会发现他不仅在帮助自己，而且还在帮助另一个在黑夜中徘徊的孤独灵魂。

[来自[url=https://cambrian42.itch.io/thenightchaser]Itch.io[/url]]
